8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.definition: The routes along which orders, reports and supplies travel to the fighting units.
8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.gloss: The routes along which orders, reports and supplies travel to the fighting units.

8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.definition: 指揮命令や情報、補給物が部隊間を往復するための通信路・補給路。物資の輸送経路も含まれる。
8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.gloss: 命令・報告・物資が戦闘部隊まで届く経路。

8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.definition: 전투 부대 사이에 명령과 정보를 전달하고 식량·탄약 등 보급품을 운반하는 경로이다. 이 통로가 끊기면 부대의 작전과 공급에 큰 문제가 생긴다.
Em contexto militar, o termo designa as rotas que ligam uma força às suas unidades, aos comandos e às fontes de abastecimento. A interrupção dessas linhas pode comprometer o desempenho da operação.
8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.gloss: Os caminhos por onde ordens, relatórios e suprimentos chegam às unidades em combate.

8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.definition: Jejak dan jaringan yang menghubungkan unit pertempur dengan komando serta sumber persediaan. Jalur ini penting karena putus-putusnya jalur komunikasi dapat menghambat perintah dan pengiriman bekal.
8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.gloss: Jalur yang digunakan untuk mengirim perintah, laporan, dan persediaan kepada unit yang bertempur.

8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.definition: เส้นทางหรือช่องทางที่ใช้ส่งคำสั่ง รายงาน และจัดส่งเสบียงไปยังหน่วยรบ การตัดขาดเส้นทางเหล่านี้อาจทำให้การสู้รบลำบาก
8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.gloss: เส้นทางที่คำสั่ง รายงาน และเสบียงเดินทางไปยังหน่วยที่ร่วมรบ

8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.definition: Haberleşme hatları, emirlerin, raporların ve erzakın savaş birliklerine ulaştığı bağlantı yollarıdır.
8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.gloss: Emir, haber ve ikmalin birliklere ulaştığı yollar.

8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.translation: น้ำท่วมตัดเส้นทางการติดต่อสื่อสารระหว่างกองทัพ
Banjir memutus jalur komunikasi antara markas dan pasukan di garis depan.
A enxurrada interrompeu as linhas de comunicação.
洪水によって通信路が切断された。

8e15c7990a737646de0cfe3f45d4134166b5f7db.text: The lines of communication were cut by the flood.

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.definition: A container with a lid that holds your drink for the whole day.
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.gloss: A container with a lid that holds your drink for the whole day.

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.definition: 水や茶などの飲み物を入れて持ち歩くための容器。ふたが付いていて、かいものにも使える。
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.gloss: 飲み物を持ち歩くための、ふた付きの容器。

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.definition: 물을或其他 음료를 보관하고 휴대하는 용기이다. 집에서 하루 동안 마실 물을 담아 두는 데 흔히 사용한다.
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.gloss: 음료를 넣고 하루 종일 가지고 다니는 뚜껑 있는 용기.

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.definition: Recipiente com tampa usado para levar água ou outra bebida. Pode ser reutilizado e mantê-lo fechado ajuda a conservar o líquido.
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.gloss: Uma garrafa com tampa para guardar a bebida.

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.definition: Wadah berbentuk botol dengan tutup yang digunakan untuk menyimpan dan membawa minuman. Botol ini biasanya dapat dipakai sepanjang hari.
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.gloss: Botol minum dengan tutup untuk membawa minuman.

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.definition: ภาชนะที่มีฝาปิดและใช้เก็บน้ำหรือเครื่องดื่มเพื่อพกติดตัวไปตลอดวัน
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.gloss: ขวดพร้อมฝาปิดสำหรับบรรจุเครื่องดื่ม

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.definition: Su veya başka bir içeceği taşımak için kullanılan, ağzı kapaklı kap. Kapağı, içeceğin taşınırken dökülmesini önler.
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.gloss: İçeceği gün boyu taşımak için kullanılan, kapaklı bir su şişesi.

I fill my water bottle at home.
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.translation: ฉันเติมน้ำในขวดน้ำที่บ้านก่อนออกไปโรงเรียน

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.text: I fill my water bottle at home.
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.translation: Saya mengisi botol minum saya dengan air di rumah.

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.text: I fill my water bottle at home.
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.translation: Enchi minha garrafa d'água em casa.

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.text: I fill my water bottle at home.
I fill my water bottle at home.
8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.translation: おけんで水筒に水をいっぱいにいれる。

8e2c12f5e195819c96bb3d4edab5a0c5e4a49d48.text: I fill my water bottle at home.

8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.definition: The total of the ages in a group divided by the number of people in it.
8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.gloss: The total of the ages in a group divided by the number of people in it.

8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.definition: 平均年齢とは、集団の年齢の総和をその人数で割った値である。
8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.gloss: 集団の年齢の総和を人数で割った値。

8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.definition: 한 집단의 모든 사람의 나이를 더한 뒤 사람 수로 나눈 값이다. 가장 나이가 많은 사람 한두 명의 나이가 전체 평균을 크게 끌어올릴 수 있다.
8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.gloss: 한 집단의 나이 합을 사람 수로 나눈 평균 나이.

8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.definition: A média das idades de um grupo, obtida dividindo a soma das idades pelo número de pessoas. Como todo promedio, ela muda bastante quando há poucos valores muito afastados dos demais.
8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.gloss: A soma das idades de um grupo dividida pelo número de pessoas do grupo.

8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.definition: Jumlah seluruh usia dalam kelompok dibagi dengan jumlah orangnya. Ukuran ini dapat dipengaruhi oleh usia yang sangat muda atau sangat tua.
ค่าเฉลี่ยของอายุในกลุ่มที่คำนวณจากผลรวมของอายุทั้งหมดหารด้วยจำนวนคน ค่านี้อาจเปลี่ยนไปมากเมื่อมีคนอายุน้อยหรือมากผิดปกติ
8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.gloss: อายุเฉลี่ยของกลุ่ม คำนวณจากผลรวมของอายุทั้งหมดหารด้วยจำนวนคน

8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.definition: Bir gruptaki yaşların toplamının gruptaki kişi sayısına bölünmesiyle bulunan ortalamadır. Her kişiyi eşit ağırlıkta saydığı için en genç ve en yaşlı kişiler sonucu aynı ölçüde etkiler.
8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.gloss: Bir gruptaki yaşların toplamının, gruptaki kişi sayısına bölünmesiyle bulunan değer.

8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.translation: Birkaç kişi diğerlerinden çok daha geç evlendiği için ortalama yaş yükseldi.
อายุเฉลี่ยเพิ่มขึ้น เพราะมีคนไม่กี่คนที่แต่งงานช้ากว่าคนอื่นมาก
Usia rata-rata meningkat karena beberapa orang menikah jauh lebih lambat daripada yang lain.
A média de idade subiu, porque algumas pessoas se casaram muito mais tarde do que as outras.
일부 사람이 다른 사람들보다 훨씬 늦게 결혼했기 때문에 평균 나이는 올라갔다.
一部の人が他の人よりかなり遅く結婚したため、平均年齢は上がった。

8e5c70b1cae6a7fb259b923b489e2d31dc4accd5.text: The mean age moved up, because a few people married much later than the rest.

8e7fc0236af43df9340685fc16f1efe36543cc17.definition: Đại từ chỉ một đối tượng đã biết.
A demonstrative pronoun for a known thing.
8e7fc0236af43df9340685fc16f1efe36543cc17.gloss: The pronoun standing for one known thing.

8e8cc5a7ecc7cf5af31c4deba5f11e97131bd324.definition: Khối văn bản thông thường, không phải danh sách hay hình ảnh.

8e8cc5a7ecc7cf5af31c4deba5f11e97131bd324.gloss: An ordinary block of running text.
